name: @ceccec/double-torus
description: The Double Torus quantum corpus — dependency-free content-address kernel (src/0): toUuid (FNV), toUuidSha256, sha256Sync (NIST-verified), merkleFold, foldPair, the vortex sequence. Deterministic, zero-egress, zero runtime dependency.

scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run verify:run && npm run verify:folds && npm run manifest:check && npm run verify:tautology && npm run verify:imports && npm run verify:paths && npm run verify:lean && npm run verify:sparkle && npm run verify:theorems && npm run verify:side-effects && npm run verify:scope && npm run verify:limits && npm run verify:lean-latex && npm run verify:lean-arbiter && npm run verify:prior-art && npm run verify:mcp-transport && npm run verify:independence && npm run verify:purity && npm run verify:fabrication && npm run verify:discoveries && npm run verify:axioms && npm run verify:titles && npm run verify:decisions && npm run verify:citation && npm run verify:bagua && npm run verify:three && npm run verify:credits && npm run verify:build-time && npm run verify:barrel && npm run verify:normaliser && npm run verify:cross-repo-pin && npm run verify:cross-repo-detection && npm run verify:statements && npm run verify:publications && npm run enforcement:trinity && npm run verify:every-fold && npm run verify:lectures && npm run verify:binary && npm run verify:ratchets && npm run verify:comments && npm run verify:figures && npm run verify:hashes
scripts.wave:verify: npm run -s check:types && npm run -s enforcement:trinity
scripts.wave:land: npm run -s quantum:autosave-matrix && npm run -s quantum:push-audit && npm run -s wave:verify && git commit -m "$(npm run -s quantum:commit-message)" && git push origin HEAD:main && npm run -s wave:after-push
scripts.wave:fuse: npm run -s wave:land && (git status --porcelain | grep -v README | grep . && echo '⚠ partial land — uncommitted remain (git add likely failed)' && exit 1 || echo '✓ clean land') && gh run list --workflow='Deploy VitePress site to Pages' --limit 1 2>/dev/null | head -1
scripts.wave:land-full: npm run -s quantum:autosave-matrix && npm run -s quantum:push-audit && npm run -s check:types && npm run -s docs:build && git commit -m "$(npm run -s quantum:commit-message)" && git push origin HEAD:main
scripts.build:package: rm -rf packages/kernel && esbuild src/0/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outfile=packages/kernel/index.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.package.json
